report_name: Senate Confirms Adam Cassady as U.S. Cyber Ambassador

identities.name: Adam Cassady
identities.description: Confirmed as the U.S. Ambassador-at-Large for Cyberspace and Digital Policy, to lead the State Department's Bureau of Cyberspace and Digital Policy.

identities.name: U.S. Senate
identities.description: The legislative body that confirmed Adam Cassady's appointment as Ambassador-at-Large for Cyberspace and Digital Policy.

identities.name: U.S. Department of State
identities.description: The U.S. federal executive department that houses the Bureau of Cyberspace and Digital Policy, which Adam Cassady will lead.

identities.name: Bureau of Cyberspace and Digital Policy
identities.description: The bureau within the U.S. State Department that Adam Cassady was confirmed to lead as Ambassador-at-Large.

identities.name: National Telecommunications and Information Administration
identities.description: The agency where Adam Cassady previously served as a senior official before his confirmation as cyber ambassador.
